record.title: Establish typed uv workspace and enforce Python conventions
record.intent: Provide separate library and Click CLI projects with reproducible dependency and quality gates.
requirements: Create a uv workspace with core and CLI subprojects, committed lockfile, Pydantic models and Click entry point delegated to application code.
Enforce formatting lint and strict typing; prohibit authored Any, untyped containers, positional tuple records, blanket ignores and unchecked casts in new workspace code.
Preserve legacy pinned scripts; document scope and commands; acquire only free tooling and use no physical interfaces.
acceptance: The workspace installs reproducibly and all initial quality gates pass.
